say:1:1023107001:1.text: Hello, did you say someone was fighting or arguing? What happened?
say:1:1023107001:1.source_cn: 嗨，听你们在说有人吵架，具体是什么情况？

say:2:1023107002:1.text: *Sigh*... We're used to it. Roliet and her father have been fighting over that poor boy from Northville. It's gotten worse these days...
say:2:1023107002:1.source_cn: 唉，我们已经司空见惯了。为了北村的那个穷小子，罗丽叶和...

say:4:1023107003:1.text: Sounds like Miss Roliet is just having a disagreement with her father. There's no need to fight, is there?
say:4:1023107003:1.source_cn: 听起来这位罗丽叶小姐和她父亲有些意见不合，他们为什么要吵架？

say:5:1023107004:1.text: Roliet doesn't want to be with anyone other than Jumeo, but her father doesn't approve of their relationship.
say:5:1023107004:1.source_cn: 这个罗丽叶，非要和北村的朱密欧在一起，可她父亲贾尔丹坚...

say:6:1023107005:1.text: She's been in an uproar this whole time. To stop his daughter from seeing that boy, Japulet has even barred the doors!
say:6:1023107005:1.source_cn: 小姑娘整天在家里搞得像要死要活的。为了阻止她去见那个男...

say:7:1023107006:1.text: That's why Jumeo wasn't able to see Roliet... She can't even go outside.
say:7:1023107006:1.source_cn: 难怪朱密欧说见不到罗丽叶……原来她根本走不出家门。

say:8:1023107007:1.text:
Japulet is being too harsh indeed if you ask me. Roliet hasn't eaten for days.
If it were me, I would never starve my own daughter.
say:8:1023107007:1.source_cn: 要说这贾尔丹也真够狠的，罗丽叶都绝食好几天了。\n换做...

say:10:1023107008:3.text: Where does our Miss Roliet live?
say:10:1023107008:3.source_cn: 这位罗丽叶小姐的家在哪儿？

say:11:1023107009:1.text: Head northwest until you see a fully fenced house.
say:11:1023107009:1.source_cn: 喏，从这里往西北面走，看见那家围满栅栏的就是了。

say:12:1023107010:1.text: Why are you stepping into this mess...? You know that Japulet drove Jumeo away, right?
say:12:1023107010:1.source_cn: 你瞎凑什么热闹呀……你忘记被贾尔丹打出去的朱密欧了？

say:13:1023107011:1.text: I understand that you came to do a good deed, but this is better left alone. Japulet is known to be as stubborn as an old goat.
say:13:1023107011:1.source_cn: 几位贵客，我相信你们是出于善意前来，但是你们最好别去管...

choice:9:1:2.text: Looks like we have to step in!
choice:9:1:2.source_cn: 看来这件事我们非管不可了！
